title: New MSFS Airports & Sceneries This Week (PC) 🌍 Palm Beach Intl, Chico & More!
description:
Looking for the best new airports in Microsoft Flight Simulator? The March 7th Marketplace Update has arrived! We're highlighting the "God-tier" Verticalsim KPBI Palm Beach, alongside SPINOZA's KCIC and more. If you want a more realistic flight sim experience, the new Real Trees scenery for Oklahoma City and Helsinki are game-changers.

Let me know in the comments: Are you picking up KPBI this week? 🌴

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 SPINOZA: KCIC Chico Regional Airport (Detailed regional airport perfect for GA operations)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KEKO Elko Regional Airport (Great stop for regional and bush-style flying)
🛫 Verticalsim: KPBI Palm Beach Intl (Highly detailed international airport ideal for airliner routes)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 Dreamscenery: Helsinki Real Trees (Adds realistic vegetation to the Helsinki area)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Oklahoma City Real Trees (Enhanced immersion with accurate tree placement)

If you enjoy staying up to date with the latest MSFS marketplace releases, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment letting me know which airport or scenery you’re picking up this week!
